description: Test whether the reported DSF2 interactors are nonspecific affinity-purification frequent flyers by counting each partner's total IntAct degree
code:
import requests, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
B="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/webservices/psicquic/intact/webservices/current/search/query/"

def partners(ac):
    r=S.get(B+ac,params={"format":"tab25","maxResults":"5000"},timeout=90)
    if r.status_code!=200 or not r.text.strip(): return None,r.status_code
    P=collections.defaultdict(set)
    for l in r.text.strip().split("\n"):
        x=l.split("\t")
        if len(x)<13: continue
        a=x[0].split(":")[-1]; b=x[1].split(":")[-1]
        o=b if a==ac else a
        P[x[8]].add(o)            # publication -> set of partners
    return P,200

names={"P11484":"SSB1 (Hsp70)","P10592":"SSA2 (Hsp70)","P02994":"TEF1","P04147":"PAB1",
       "P16140":"VMA2","Q03940":"RVB1","P30822":"CRM1","P48363":"PAC10","Q08273":"HRT1/RBX1","P48581":"RAD17"}
rows=[]
for ac,nm in names.items():
    P,st=partners(ac)
    if P is None: rows.append((nm,ac,None,None,st)); continue
    allp=set().union(*P.values()) if P else set()
    gav=len(P.get("pubmed:16429126",set()))
    rows.append((nm,ac,len(allp),gav,st))
    print(f"{nm:16s} {ac}  total distinct partners in IntAct: {len(allp):5d}   partners in Gavin 2006 (PMID 16429126): {gav}")

lab=[r[0] for r in rows]; tot=[r[2] or 0 for r in rows]
col=["#d62828" if t>=300 else "#1f4e79" for t in tot]
plt.figure(figsize=(7.2,4.0))
y=range(len(rows))
plt.barh(list(y)[::-1],tot,color=col)
plt.yticks(list(y)[::-1],lab,fontsize=8)
plt.xlabel("distinct partners reported in IntAct (all publications)")
plt.title("DSF2 physical-interaction partners are dominated by\nhigh-degree affinity-purification frequent flyers",fontsize=9.5)
plt.grid(axis="x",alpha=.3)
for k,t in enumerate(tot): plt.text(t+15,len(rows)-1-k,str(t),va="center",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
